name: POINT
description: Creates a geographic point from latitude and longitude coordinates, in that order.

examples.title: Distance from a point
examples.description: How far each store is from Paris, in metres
examples.sql: SELECT ST_DISTANCE(location, POINT(48.8566, 2.3522)) as distance_m FROM stores

examples.title: Use in distance calculation
examples.sql:
SELECT name, ST_DISTANCE(location, POINT(48.8566, 2.3522)) as distance_from_paris
FROM cities

examples.title: Filter by distance from a point
examples.description: Stores within 1000 metres of the point
examples.sql: SELECT name FROM stores WHERE ST_DISTANCE(location, POINT(40.7484, -73.9857)) < 1000

notes: Latitude is first, longitude is second - NOT the GeoJSON order
POINT has no standalone form: it is only accepted as an argument to ST_DISTANCE. In the syntax above, location is the indexed geo_point column
A coordinate must be written with a decimal point: POINT(1.0, 2.0) is accepted, POINT(1, 2) is not
